text: Oh, you're not from around here?\nIt's rare to have a customer like you.

Welcome to Vicus Mutans!\nFeel free to walk around, but please, no fighting.
Ah, a new face.\nHow do you like it here? It's a nice place,\nisn't it? Take your time and relax.
Hey, don't you have anything interesting?\nI'd be thrilled if you've got some new fashion\nstuff!
Oh, you guys are new here...\nWelcome, welcome. No matter what your race or\nhow you look, you're welcome here...
An unusual village deep in the jungle.\n[ffff64]Vicus Mutans[ffffff]
T-the Eumano and Rana are living together.\nWhat's going on here?!
Wait a sec! The Elf and the Cule are here too...\nIs this place connected to our world too?!
Do you know this kid?\nIt seems that you are from the outside world.
Welcome to [ffff64]Vicus Mutans[ffffff]!\nThose who were once Coenubia live in this village.
I will say it again.\nAll the inhabitants of Vicus Mutans used to be\nCoenubia that have changed form...
When this world collided with your world, some\nCoenubias learned about human thoughts and\nkindness. The information was then spread.
Those influenced by it broke away from the group,\neach taking on the form they preferred, which gave\nrise to the civilization of Vicus Mutans...
Could something like that really happen...?
It could happen...Coenubias assimilate various\norganisms to acquire information which is then\nshared with their colony...
Human thoughts and emotions such as kindness are\nincomprehensible concepts they have been\naccumulating over time.
One day, a Coenubia that could understand them\nappeared, developed Sapien-like emotions and took\non a Sapien-like form. That's how it happened.
I think your logic is sound...\nMaybe what you said is right?
Oh, you think so? I'm kinda dumb, so I'm not sure,\nbut I guess that's roughly how it happened.\nIf I'm actually right, that's amazing, hahaha!
No one here will attack you.\nSo please feel free to relax and enjoy yourselves.
